_comment: Mutation survivors accepted as a baseline for the core sweep. The nightly ratchet fails when a survivor appears outside this set, and when an entry is no longer a survivor. Regenerate with `python scripts/mutation_gate.py --baseline core --update` after a sweep, and only ever let this set shrink. Entries are the survivor line without its line:col position, so they survive unrelated code motion.

_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision.rs: re: `Kind::NoneType`'s region is `1 << 0`, and `1 >> 0` is the same value. A genuinely equivalent mutant, and the only one of the seven shift constants that is: the other six are killed by `every_kind_lands_in_the_partition_and_the_scalars_land_apart`, which requires each scalar kind's region to be non-empty and pairwise disjoint and every container kind to share the one that is left.
